schools.title: Cambridge ELLIS Unit Summer School on Probabilistic Machine Learning
schools.description: Five-day summer school on probabilistic ML, covering advanced probabilistic models, generative models, causality, and accelerating science, with lectures and panel discussions.

schools.title: Machine Learning Summer School on Reliability & Safety
schools.description: Five-day summer school on AI safety, reliability, and robustness of ML systems, with invited lectures from leading researchers and a poster session.

schools.title: 9th Advanced Course on Data Science & Machine Learning – ACDL 2026, from AI Agents to Agentic AI
schools.description: Five-day full-immersion course on AI agents, agentic AI, deep learning, data science, and generative AI, with lectures delivered by world-renowned experts.

schools.title: Learning Theory Summer School (LTSS) Copenhagen 2026
schools.description: Four-day summer school (with optional two-day workshop) on modern learning theory and responsible machine learning: generalization, optimization for ML, online and reinforcement learning, privacy, and robustness.

schools.title: Machine Learning for Molecules 2026
schools.description: Summer school on ML for molecular and materials science: property prediction, ML potentials, graph neural networks, self-driving labs, and generative/LLM-based synthesis prediction, with lectures, tutorials, and poster session.

schools.title: ProbAI School 2026
schools.description: School in probabilistic machine learning, covering probabilistic modeling, variational inference, deep generative models, latent variable methods, normalizing flows, neural ODEs, and probabilistic programming.

schools.title: Machine Learning Summer School 2026
schools.description: The 50th edition of the Machine Learning Summer School featuring intensive lectures, tutorials, and poster sessions by leading researchers in machine learning.
schools.where: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, Tübingen, Germany

schools.title: ELLIS Summer School 2026: AI for Research
schools.description: Five-day summer school on AI for scientific research: AI-assisted research workflows, trustworthy AI and learning under uncertainty, safe scientific agents, generative models, and physics-informed AI across chemistry, physics, biology and health, with a multi-day hackathon.

schools.title: KCDS Summer School 2026 on Graph Neural Networks
schools.description: Five-day summer school on Graph Neural Networks, covering the mathematical foundations and real-world applications of graph-based machine learning through lectures, interactive sessions, and hands-on tutorials, plus a poster session.

schools.title: Machine Learning Summer School 2027 Okinawa
schools.description: Two-week summer school for master's and PhD students with a strong ML background, featuring lectures from leading researchers on PAC-Bayes and learning theory, optimal transport, diffusion and world models, kernel methods, bandits, language models, and trustworthy ML, with daily poster and social sessions.
schools.where: Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology (OIST), Onna, Okinawa, Japan
schools.contact: Registration expected to open August 2026 via OpenReview. See page for details.

schools.title: 2027 Spring School on Data-driven Model Learning of Dynamic Systems
schools.description: Five-day PhD course on data-driven modeling (system identification): the fundamentals of linear system identification and experiment design, plus advanced topics like Bayesian estimation and Gaussian processes, combining lectures with hands-on Matlab exercises.
schools.where: Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Ecully, France (hybrid, with virtual attendance option)
schools.contact: Register via the linked conference page.
